title: Remove Launch control history flat aliases
summary: Removed five additional Launch flat compatibility aliases by routing command-history pipeline-control rendering through mediaPipelineLaunchView and keeping start-request/archive helpers namespace-backed.
reason: The active WebView cleanup workstream calls for opportunistic reduction of transitional window.* exports while preserving namespace-first access, test hooks, and backend-owned command boundaries.
behavior_before: launchView.js exported pipeline-control history helpers, state-journal archive start, and CSV rerun request collection as direct flat window.* aliases. commandHistory.js called renderPipelineControlHistory through a flat global.
behavior_after: commandHistory.js dispatches pipeline-control history rendering through mediaPipelineLaunchView. launchView.js keeps the same helpers on mediaPipelineLaunchView but no longer publishes isPipelineControlCommand, pipelineControlHistoryLine, renderPipelineControlHistory, startStateJournalArchive, or collectRerunStartRequest as flat globals.
tests_added: Tightened LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype assertions for Launch namespace usage and removed flat assignments.
Updated WebViewCommandEvidenceSmokeTests to require the pipeline-control history renderer through mediaPipelineLaunchView.
manual_validation: npm run webview:contract (OK; regenerated public contract baseline)
npm run webview:prework:check (OK after moving namespace dispatch into a helper and regenerating contract baseline)
rollback_plan: Restore the five launchView.js flat assignments and the direct commandHistory.js flat-global dispatch, then rerun the targeted Local API, command-evidence, inventory, browser smoke, and WebView prework checks.
